title: Do THIS First in RuneScape Dragonwilds
author: Spopes
chapters: Part 2: Getting in the Game (Trading & Account)
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is finally here! This guide breaks down everything you need to do first when loading into the full release on PC and console.

Dragonwilds is RuneScape like you’ve never experienced it before. Jagex has taken the iconic world and skills of Gielinor and evolved them into a brand-new sandbox survival crafting RPG. After a highly successful year in early access, the official 1.0 version is launching on September 15th for $29.99 with full crossplay support.

Whether you are an Old School RuneScape (OSRS) veteran or a survival game fan, this guide covers the essential day one roadmap. Learn which skills to level up fast (like Agility and Woodcutting), how to unlock melee weapon special actions at level 8 Attack, how magic and ranged combat work without a Grand Exchange, and the best practices for building your starter base to survive monster raids. Master your progression early so your squad can gear up in Rune armor and prepare for the 4-player endgame raid!
